content: <thought>We have obtained the mass spectrum (M⁺ at m/z 194.09) indicating a molecular formula of C₁₄H₁₀O. The ¹³C NMR shows 12 distinct signals: aromatic carbons at 147, 133.9, 128.9 ×2, 127.7 ×2 and aliphatic carbons at 44.1, 34.5 ×2, 26.9 ×2, 26.2 ppm, consistent with a phenolic aromatic system bearing a partially saturated aliphatic fragment. The proton NMR (to be retrieved) will allow us to pinpoint the exact structure among the plausible isomers. Once the proton data are available, we will match the observed chemical shifts and multiplicities to the candidate SMILES and confirm the correct one.
